headline: Power outage in fire at Moghbazar grid, parts of Dhaka city dark
summary: A fire at the Moghbazar substation has disrupted electricity supply to several surrounding areas of the capital.
details: A fire broke out at the Moghbazar grid substation in Dhaka, causing widespread power outages across several parts of the city.
The disruption in electricity supply began around noon, leaving many residents and businesses in the surrounding areas without power.
Firefighters and technical teams are working to manage the situation and restore power to the affected regions.
The cause of the fire at the substation has not yet been officially confirmed, but efforts are underway to stabilize the grid.

headline: Dhaka: Railway engineer killed by woman over relationship dispute
summary: A sub-assistant engineer of the Bangladesh Railway was stabbed to death by a woman in the capital city following a conflict over their relationship.
details: A sub-assistant engineer of the Bangladesh Railway was killed in Dhaka after being stabbed by a woman.
According to reports, the incident occurred due to a dispute over their relationship.
The victim was a railway official, and the attack was carried out by the woman with whom he had a relationship.
Police are investigating the case to determine the full circumstances surrounding the stabbing.
